name: offline-drift
description: Analyst 6.44 (ii) (11-11 ~21:10): the offline drift test. The F-P / T-P-Ne pair trained one pass on 10.8M of P2x (ply-1 field's models at ply 2) then 10.8M of P2, against the pair trained on P2 alone; cold, T 0.02, plies 1-2, 150 round-robins. Verdict on head-to-heads at ply 2: lag predicts the drifted tree within 20 of its flat (the P2-alone tree beats its flat by ~65); a drifted tree still 40+ ahead means another loop term (self-games, T 0.1 gate, late splits).
